title.zh: Training a 4B model to produce 81% faster query plans than Postgres
title.en: Training a 4B model to produce 81% faster query plans than Postgres

current_state.zh: A blog post describes training a 4B-parameter model to generate query plans reported as 81% faster than Postgres, with HN commenters praising the accessible engineering write-up while cautioning that the benchmark's in-memory, warmed, read-only setup may not generalize to realistic OLTP workloads.
